title: test_presence.py: missing PresenceCache.from_cbor error path tests
description: TestPresenceCacheCodec lacks tests for from_cbor error handling. TestPresenceCodec has test_rejects_non_bytes_payload and test_rejects_invalid_cbor for Presence.from_cbor, but no equivalent tests exist for PresenceCache.from_cbor. The implementation (presence.py:254-266) has the same validation (type check for bytes, CBOR decode exception wrapping) but it is untested. Add tests for PresenceCache.from_cbor with bytearray input and malformed CBOR input.
